jobs.description: Color schemes inspired by job identities

palettes.name: Maelstrom
palettes.description: Limsa Lominsa's naval standard — storm red and jet black over sea-spray white.

palettes.name: Twin Adders
palettes.description: Gridania's forest guard — an oath kept in leaf-light and deep wood.

palettes.name: Immortal Flames
palettes.description: Ul'dah's standing army — soot black and ember red, flames that never gutter.

palettes.name: Spring
palettes.description: First thaw — petal pink, seedling green and pale morning light.

palettes.name: Summer
palettes.description: High summer — deep harbour water, bright sail and warm sand.

palettes.name: Autumn
palettes.description: The turning wood — pumpkin orange, mossy brown and mulled red.

palettes.name: Winter
palettes.description: Deep winter — fresh snow, ice blue and a gleam of frozen silver.

palettes.name: Starlight Celebration
palettes.description: Saint's red coats and evergreen boughs on fresh snow, lighting the city squares.

palettes.name: Moonfire Faire
palettes.description: Bombards by the shore — sea blue, sun-bleached white and a spark of festival flame.

palettes.name: The Rising
palettes.description: The realm remembers its rebirth — anniversary gold and regal purple over pearl.

palettes.name: Hatching-tide
palettes.description: Painted archon eggs on parade — sweetshop pastels and spring ribbon.

palettes.name: Valentione's Day
palettes.description: Courtship red, blushing pink and lace white — love letters done in dye.

palettes.name: Heavensturn
palettes.description: Ringing in the year, Far Eastern style — ceremonial red, deep lacquer and temple gold.

palettes.name: Little Ladies' Day
palettes.description: Peach blossoms for the princesses' parade — pale petals, one bright cherry, festival white.

palettes.name: All Saints' Wake
palettes.description: Pumpkin lantern, witching black and an imp's plum purple — the Continental Circus in three dyes.
